parse.title: Lumbridge & Draynor Diary
parse.wikitext:
===Rewards===
*[[Explorer's ring 1]]:
**Can restore 50% of [[Energy|run energy]] twice a day
**Allows 30 casts of [[Low Level Alchemy]] without [[runes]] each day (no experience granted unless done at the [[Alchemist's Playground]], still requires 21 [[Magic]])
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill level of at least level 30
